# Docs Index

This folder contains stable integration and developer references for the coding agent. Runtime/exported artifacts are generated on demand under `docs/agent-*` when the default artifact root is used, but historical generated artifacts are not kept in the repository.

## Integration Docs

- [Machine-State Schema](./machine-state-schema.md)
- [Machine-State API Contract](./machine-state-api.md)
- [Preview Home API](./preview-home-api.md)
- [Integration Guide](./integration-guide.md)
- [Demo App](../apps/demo/README.md)

## Runtime Artifacts

By default, exported plans, reviews, approvals, workflows, traces, dashboard snapshots, bundle indexes, and machine-state files are written under `docs/agent-*`. These are runtime outputs and can be deleted safely; fresh runs recreate the needed directories/files.

## Suggested Reading Order

1. Read the implementation plan to understand the architecture and roadmap.
2. Read the machine-state schema and API contract if you are integrating UI or automation.
3. Inspect `docs/agent-*` only when auditing artifacts generated by a concrete local run.
